group.passage:
The Rubik’s Cube is a cube-shaped puzzle with nine small squares on each side. Initially, each side has the same color—red, green, yellow, orange, blue, and white. The goal is to return each side to its original color after turning the cube. As easy as it may sound, solving the puzzle proves challenging because each square—mini cube itself—has different colors on each side. With more than 20 mini cubes, there are 43,252,003,274,489,856,000 ways to arrange the colors. However, only one combination is correct.
The challenge it presents is the very reason the Rubik’s Cube was popular when it appeared in the late 70s and has remained so for more than 50 years. No one is more surprised at the success than its creator Ernő Rubik. At that time, the Hungarian architect was toying with the idea of a new kind of building structure. The wood model he created turned out to be popular among his friends as they all tried to turn the squares back to their original positions. In 1975, a multi-colored cube called Magic Cube hit the market. Four years later, Magic Cube was renamed Rubik’s Cube and appeared in the US. The rest is history.
Though versions of the Rubik’s Cube have changed with time, its inner work, which enables individual parts to move around without the whole structure falling apart, remains the same. Three types of pieces, or mini cubes, make up the cube. Centerpieces are fixed in place and never move; edge pieces connect the centerpieces and can move along an edge, while corner pieces connect three faces of the cube and can move around a corner. The core is at the center of the cube, holding six centerpieces together, while the edge pieces and corner pieces are secured to the core with screws.
Despite its unassuming looks and simple design, the Rubik’s Cube will continue to attract the public.

figures.caption: 第4題：標示 A、B、C 三個部位的魔術方塊圖
figures.description: 題目右側一張灰階的 3×3 魔術方塊立體圖：方塊右側的一整片（一層）被轉動到一半，與左側未轉動的部分錯開，露出兩部分之間的縫隙。三條引線各指向一個小方塊：A（圖左側）的引線指向左側面中間一列、位於該面邊緣中段的小方塊（不在角上，也不在面的正中央）；B（圖右上）的引線指向被轉動那一面的正中央小方塊（3×3 面的中心格）；C（圖右下）的引線指向被轉動那一面最下方的角落小方塊（位於方塊的角上，連接三個面）。
